notes_for_editor: Read: two FFLA Virginia county lists, Wikipedia's Rassawek article, the Rassawek property's history page and a Virginia lookout index. A Facebook group post about the East Leake tower returned only its title, so it is not used. A Waymarking page describes a different Goochland tower relocated from Hanover County to Field Day of the Past; it is not this tower and is not used. A summarising fetch of the rassawek.com homepage described a vineyard at a River Road address in Columbia, but fetch_text did not find those words, so that is not used. Whether the listed Rassawek point sits on the vineyard property or the archaeological site is unresolved. The destination record us-va-east-leake-at-rassawek.json was not changed.
